ai_summary: The Township of Admaston/Bromley adopted Bylaw 2023-61 to establish regulations for backyard chickens. Concurrently, Council also adopted an amendment to its Fees and Charges By-Law 2023-62, establishing a new permit charge for backyard chickens.

The Township of Brudenell, Lyndoch and Raglan is proposing a new comprehensive zoning by-law to update and combine its existing zoning regulations. This new by-law includes provisions that will permit backyard chickens as an accessory use to a dwelling unit, requiring chicken coops to comply with accessory building setbacks.

The municipality included an "Addendum to 2024 Development Charges Background Study" on its July 18, 2024, Hybrid Meeting Agenda. This signifies Council's active engagement with an update or revision to the foundational document used for establishing development charges within the municipality.
